International Jack & Jill / The 2026 competition story

The competition dossier / 2026 reference

### Meet the moment. Make it yours.

The International Jack & Jill brings dancers from across Europe together on the Milano stage. It is a chance to put your social dancing into focus, with connection, musicality and technique at the centre.

The 2026 jury is composed of international Bachata masters. The competition offers dancers a platform to be seen by experienced artists, share their dancing and take the next step in their development.

**2026 competition date**

Sunday, 22 November 2026

**Entry fee**

€20 + platform booking fees

**Required admission**

Full Pass / Full Social Pass

**Registration platform**

Salsadelbaile

The 2026 prizes

### An opening for what comes next.

These prizes belong to the 2026 competition. The invitation to the 2027 artist lineup is a 2026 winner’s prize, not a confirmed 2027 competition award.

01 / THE ARTIST INVITATION

#### A place in the 2027 lineup.

The winner of the 2026 International Jack & Jill receives an invitation to join the official artist lineup for Milano Sensual Congress 2027.

02 / THE NEXT EDITION

#### Full Passes for the finalists.

Top finalists in the 2026 competition receive Full Passes for the next edition, continuing their congress experience.

03 / THE EXPERIENCE

#### A stage. A new perspective.

Share your dancing with the international Bachata community and bring the experience back to your own practice.

2026 entry reference
